programs.title: Ragini MMS
programs.desc: A horror film that follows the story of a couple, who visit a secluded farmhouse for a weekend getaway. However, their vacation turns into a nightmare when they realize they are not alone and their intimate moments are being recorded. The movie features suspenseful thrills and explores themes of voyeurism and supernatural terror in a unsettling plot.

programs.title: Kiss Kis Ko
programs.desc: A group of young Indian men calling themselves Band of Boys decide to perform publicly, to share their talents India-wide, as well as to make a career for themselves. It seems the public is only interested seeing a group of girls perform.
